delegated-data-collection-vs-nursing-jud: Separate routine measurement from nursing interpretation and evaluation.
delegation-circumstances-and-change: Reassess delegation when the client's circumstances change.
unexpected-finding-requires-rn-assessmen: Do not delay RN assessment of an unexpected concerning finding.
lpn-authorized-routine-task: Match LPN assignments to the stated scope, competence, and established care plan.
right-supervision-evaluation-follow-up: Delegation includes follow-up and RN evaluation of the client's response.
scope-matched-assignment: Both role authorization and procedure-specific competence are needed.
rn-retains-accountability: The RN remains accountable for the delegation decision; each person remains accountable for their own actions.
donning-gloves-cover-cuffs: During donning, extend gloves over the gown cuffs.
doffing-separate-removal-sequence: Use the specified PPE removal method; CDC describes more than one method.
hand-hygiene-after-doffing: Clean hands after PPE removal and promptly if contamination occurs during removal.
standard-precautions-apply-to-all: Standard precautions continue for every client; select measures based on exposure risk.
mask-removal-handle-by-ties: Remove a used surgical mask by its ties or loops without touching the front.
safe-work-practices-clean-to-dirty: Avoid transferring contamination to the face or a clean site; change gloves and clean hands when indicated.
goggles-removal-by-headband: Handle used eye protection by its headband or ear pieces and send reusable items for reprocessing.
postoperative-stridor-urgent-airway-asse: Recognize postoperative stridor as an urgent airway warning in these scenarios.
acute-change-vs-stable-baseline: Prioritize the new concerning change over an unchanged stable baseline in the stated comparison.
bleeding-urgency-and-circulation: Active significant bleeding and associated symptoms warrant urgent assessment and escalation.
unstable-vitals-require-assessment: Interpret concerning vital signs together with the client's symptoms and trend.
new-change-vs-baseline: Promptly assess a new mental-status change instead of accepting it as baseline.
new-respiratory-deterioration-vs-routine: A falling oxygen saturation with new breathlessness needs prompt attention over routine requests.
acetaminophen-duplicate-active-ingredien: Compare active ingredients to avoid duplicate acetaminophen products.
warfarin-consistent-vitamin-k-intake: Keep vitamin K intake consistent during warfarin treatment and discuss major changes.
levothyroxine-calcium-separation: Separate the specified levothyroxine tablet and calcium by at least four hours.
alendronate-tablet-water-and-upright: Follow the FOSAMAX tablet's water, fasting, and upright instructions.
metformin-er-swallow-whole: Do not cut, crush, or chew the specified metformin ER tablet; seek a suitable alternative.
metoprolol-succinate-er-permitted-splitt: For the verified splittable metoprolol ER product, swallow the prescribed portion without crushing or chewing.
ciprofloxacin-antacid-separation: For CIPRO and the specified antacid, distinguish two hours before from six hours after.
apixaban-missed-dose-not-doubled: Follow the stated ELIQUIS missed-dose directions without doubling a dose.
lantus-not-mixed: Do not mix the specified LANTUS insulin with another insulin.
insulin-pen-single-patient-use: An insulin pen is for one patient, even when a new needle is used.
nitrostat-original-container: Keep NITROSTAT in its original glass container with the cap tightly closed.
antibiotics-not-for-uncomplicated-viral-: Antibiotics do not treat an uncomplicated viral cold.
opioid-alcohol-additive-depression: Avoid alcohol during opioid treatment because the combination can dangerously depress breathing and alertness.
liquid-medication-matched-measuring-devi: Measure an oral liquid with a suitable medication device marked in the prescribed units.
medication-history-includes-otc-and-supp: Include OTC medicines and supplements in a current medication list.
tablet-splitting-product-specific-verifi: Verify splitting instructions for the exact tablet product.
antibiotic-plan-not-self-shortened: Follow the current prescribed antibiotic plan and seek advice before changing it yourself.
expired-medicine-replacement-not-appeara: Do not rely on appearance or an intact seal to justify using an expired medicine.
drug-facts-active-ingredient-versus-use: Use the active-ingredient section to identify duplicate OTC medicines and amounts.
unused-medicine-accessible-take-back: Use an available authorized take-back option; follow product-specific disposal guidance when it is unavailable.
teach-back-checks-explanation: Use teach-back to check understanding and adjust the explanation when needed.
smoking-cessation-supported-plan: Offer evidence-supported help for quitting rather than treating medication or counseling as failure.
mild-illness-vaccine-screening: Distinguish mild illness from a more substantial acute illness during vaccine screening.
home-bp-standardized-technique: Use consistent positioning, rest, and appropriate cuff fit for home BP measurements.
dementia-clear-respectful-communication: Communicate respectfully with simple wording and enough time to respond.
anxiety-listen-without-false-reassurance: Invite discussion of the concern without promising that a procedure has no risk.
grief-offer-support-without-imposed-time: Listen and offer support without imposing one way or timeline for grieving.
hallucinations-acknowledge-distress-not-: Acknowledge distress without affirming a hallucination, while addressing safety concerns.
pressure-injury-prevention-without-massa: Avoid vigorous rubbing or massage of vulnerable skin in pressure-injury prevention.
catheter-unobstructed-dependent-drainage: Keep catheter drainage dependent and unobstructed, with the bag off the floor.
dry-mouth-comfort-within-fluid-plan: Choose dry-mouth comfort measures consistent with swallowing safety and the fluid plan.
sleep-support-environment-and-routine: Support sleep with a suitable environment and consistent routines.
peripheral-iv-phlebitis-requires-action: Act on peripheral-IV phlebitis signs even if the infusion still flows.
possible-gi-bleeding-prompt-evaluation: Possible GI bleeding warrants prompt evaluation rather than automatic reassurance.
possible-pe-emergency-recognition: Escalate sudden postoperative breathlessness and chest pain urgently.
allergy-history-verify-and-document: Clarify and reconcile a newly reported drug reaction before routine administration.
new-stroke-signs-emergency-response: Treat sudden stroke-like symptoms as an emergency, including when symptoms improve.
adult-low-glucose-safe-oral-treatment: Use oral fast-acting carbohydrate only when the person can swallow safely and the stated protocol applies.
asthma-unrelieved-severe-breathing-emerg: Severe asthma symptoms unrelieved by prescribed treatment require emergency help.
heart-failure-consistent-weight-tracking: Compare daily heart-failure weights under consistent conditions and follow the reporting plan.
unanswered-procedure-questions-before-co: Unanswered procedure-specific risks or alternatives require the responsible procedural clinician before the consent process proceeds.
pulmonary-tb-airborne-controls: For infectious pulmonary TB, use airborne controls; a patient mask does not replace a fit-tested respirator for staff entering the room.
convulsive-seizure-protect-without-restr: Protect the person during a convulsive seizure without restraining movements or placing objects in the mouth; oral intake waits until fully alert.
infant-sleep-back-firm-flat-empty: Place an infant on the back for each sleep in a separate firm, flat sleep space with only a fitted sheet.
suicide-cue-direct-nonjudgmental-inquiry: Ask directly and without judgment about suicide when a client gives a concerning cue; reassurance or avoidance does not assess safety.
lithium-consistent-salt-and-fluid-plan: Follow the prescribed salt and fluid plan while taking lithium; abrupt low-salt diets or dehydration need clinician guidance.
dialysis-access-arm-protection: Protect the AV fistula arm from routine blood-pressure cuffs, non-dialysis venipuncture and IV placement, and external compression.
suspected-transfusion-reaction-stop-befo: When a transfusion reaction is suspected, stop the blood product promptly while initiating assessment and the facility response protocol.
gastric-tube-feeding-head-elevation: During gastric tube feeding, maintain prescribed head-of-bed elevation, commonly 30–45 degrees unless contraindicated, alongside the other feeding safety checks.
standard-cane-opposite-weak-leg: With a standard prescribed cane plan for a weak leg, hold the cane in the opposite hand; individualized therapy instructions take precedence.
